geeklist.description:
[floatleft][imageid=9188966 medium][/floatleft][color=#ff0000][b]Auction will close sometime in the evening (EST) of Sunday, November 9, 2025[/b]. I will not close the auction within 20 minutes of a bid being placed.[/color]
[u][b]Auction Rules[/b][/u]
:d10-1: [b]BIDDING:[/b] * All games will be listed with a [b][COLOR=#009900]minimum bid[/COLOR][/b]. Please do not place bids under the minimum, but you may Geekmail me with alternative offers. * Please consider your bid to be a commitment to buy the item at that price should you win the item. If you are not certain you want to buy the item at your bid price, please wait to bid until you are. Please do your research [i]before[/i] placing a bid, and do not delete/withdraw a bid without contacting me first. * Please use the comments at the bottom of the list for questions or discussion, and reply to individual items only to place bids. * Any item without bids may have its minimum and BIN prices changed or be withdrawn from the auction. * Please bid in increments of $1 or more. * If you are interested in an item, I suggest you signal this by placing a bid early. Items without bids are more likely to be traded during the course of the auction.
:d10-2: [b][COLOR=#FF0000]BUY-IT-NOW[/COLOR][/b]: * A bid at the [COLOR=#FF0000][b]BIN[/b][/COLOR] level automatically closes the auction for that item. It will also mark you as a person of decision! * Cash or trade offers through other avenues may also be accepted as a BIN during the auction.
:d10-3: [b][COLOR=#0033FF]GAME CONDITION[/COLOR][/b]: * I will do my very best to give an accurate description of the game condition. I take good care of my games, but these have been transported around and people have used them! I will note any damage that is noticeable to me. Unless the game is described as "like new" or better, do expect some minor wear on the boxes and rulebooks. I often discard unhelpful inserts in favor of bags or plastic container boxes for organization. Let me know if you really care about getting the original insert. You are likely to find helpful color printed player aids in the box.
:d10-4: [b]AUCTION END[/b]: * Auction will close at a time within the window specified. I will update the list header and call out auction winners for each item at this time. Please consider the auction closed automatically at the end of the closing window if I fail to update the list. I will not close the auction within 20 minutes of a bid being placed.
:d10-5: [b][COLOR=#009900]SHIPPING:[/COLOR][/b] * Shipping charge will be [COLOR=#009900][b]actual USPS or UPS cost[/b][/COLOR] from 01522 USA (central Massachusetts) rounded up to the nearest dollar and will be paid by the winner. I will work to find the least expensive option (Pirateship & Shippo discounted rates) for each package. I don't like paying for shipping either, and I don't want you to pay any more than necessary. * International bidders are welcome, but be prepared for high shipping charges, and please bid only with this in mind. * I would be happy to do [COLOR=#009900][b]local pick-ups[/b][/color] in the [b]Worcester (and potentially Cambridge and in between) Massachusetts[/b] areas. For low value items, you would likely need to come to my house in Holden. * I will also be happy to [COLOR=#009900][b]combine shipping[/b][/color] if you win multiple items!
:d10-6: [b][COLOR=#663399]PAYMENT:[/COLOR][/b] * Paypal or money order payment is fine (or even a check if you are willing to wait 2 weeks for it to clear). I can also accept cash or Venmo for a local pickup.
:gg: [b][COLOR=#CC9933]GEEKGOLD BONUS[/COLOR][/b] * As a thank you for for participating in my auction, you can expect to receive a [COLOR=#CC9933][b]Geekgold tip[/b][/COLOR] (1GG/$10) for your [u]first[/u] bid for each item placed [u]prior[/u] to the final 48 hours.
[i]:D Game on my friends! :D[/i]
